title: DocsbookInsightReport
description: Machine-readable analytics report produced by a docs-insights skill or subagent. Designed for consumption by downstream agents (actor, todo-writer, github-issue-opener, docs-editor) without re-running the analytics MCP calls.

schema_version.description: Incremented on breaking changes to this schema. Downstream readers MUST verify this before parsing.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this report was produced.

version.description: SemVer of the skill that produced this report.

model.description: Model that produced the report (for cost auditing).

plan.description: Workspace plan at time of analysis (drives which MCP tools were available).

summary.description: Roll-up numbers for quick consumption by a parent agent or a dashboard.

headline.description: One-sentence TL;DR safe to paste into Slack.

data_sources.description: Which MCP tools were called to produce this report. Lets the actor know what evidence backs each finding without recalling the tools.

findings.description: Discrete, addressable observations. Each finding is independently actionable.

next_run.description: Suggested cadence for re-running this skill.

id.description: Stable identifier: <skill>:<finding-kind>:<slug>. Lets downstream agents deduplicate across runs. Example: docs-utm-analyzer:bounce-on-utm:launch-hn-quick-start.

type.description: Coarse-grained category. Downstream actor maps type→default action.

severity.description: critical = blocks conversion or fires on >5% of traffic; high = clear regression; medium = optimization; low = cleanup; info = neutral observation.

confidence.description: How sure the skill is. Downstream actor SHOULD ignore findings below 0.5 unless explicitly told to.

title.description: Single sentence — what the finding is. Imperative or descriptive, no marketing fluff.

summary.description: Markdown-formatted 1–5 sentence explanation. Quote numbers from evidence.

evidence.description: Structured facts that justify the finding. Lets actor agents reason without re-querying MCP.

metrics.description: Flat key/value of headline numbers (e.g. {pageviews: 12400, bounce_rate: 0.78}).

pages.description: Documentation pages this finding is about.

samples.description: Representative raw items: example user questions, example UTM URLs, example visitor_ids. Capped at 20.

suggested_actions.description: Machine-readable hints for the downstream actor agent. Actor MAY pick one, all, or none. Order = author's recommendation.

action_type.description: Vocabulary the future actor agent dispatches on. Keep this set small and stable.

target.description: Action-type-specific target: file path for edit_page; new path for create_page; repo for open_github_issue; channel for notify_slack; skill name for invoke_skill.

skill_to_invoke.description: Preferred when action_type=invoke_skill. Names another Docsbook skill that can carry out the work (e.g. docs-tune-ai-chat, docs-editor, docs-gap-finder).

prompt.description: Pre-filled instruction for the invoked skill or PR/Issue body. Should be self-contained — the actor agent will paste it without this report attached.

priority.description: p0 = act today; p1 = this sprint; p2 = backlog; p3 = nice-to-have.

estimated_effort.description: T-shirt size: xs=<15min, s=<1h, m=<half-day, l=<2 days, xl=multi-day project.

blocked_by.description: IDs of other findings that must be resolved first. Lets the actor topologically sort actions.

auto_apply_safe.description: If true, an actor running in --auto mode MAY execute this without user confirmation. Default false. Set true only for reversible, observable actions (open Issue, add_to_todo, notify_slack).
